name: @brevi/desktop
description: Mission Control as a desktop app: an Electron shell that owns and supervises the brevi orchestrator.

scripts.build: bun build src/main/index.ts --outfile dist/main.js --target=node --format=esm --external electron && cp src/renderer/status.html dist/status.html
scripts.stage: bun run build && bun run scripts/stage-cli.ts
scripts.package: bun run stage && electron-builder --publish never -c.extraMetadata.version=$(bun scripts/cli-version.ts)
scripts.package:mac: bun run build && bun run scripts/stage-cli.ts --darwin-universal && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never -c.extraMetadata.version=$(bun scripts/cli-version.ts)
scripts.package:linux: bun run stage && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never -c.extraMetadata.version=$(bun scripts/cli-version.ts)
